name: text2video-energy-benchmark-generated-videos
description: A benchmark of synthetic videos produced by text-to-video models designed to evaluate tradeoffs between generation quality and energy/compute characteristics. It provides generated video examples paired with source prompts to measure fidelity, temporal coherence, and resource footprint of text-to-video systems. Evaluations typically combine automated perceptual metrics and human judgments to assess realism and prompt alignment.
general_score_metric: Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) / human evaluation score
reputation: A niche research dataset used by text-to-video researchers; limited but growing adoption for studying generation quality and energy tradeoffs.
